title: 宝塚記念の後に・導く者

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I win the Takarazuka Kinen. But more and more people are saying I'm not princess-like…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No matter! I'm pursuing the ideal princess I envision—one that I can be proud of! Yeah, Vodka knows what I'm talking about!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My next challenge is the Queen Elizabeth II Cup. There are still people saying I'm not fit to be queen, but that's no problem!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My peers are all pursuing their own ideal selves, so I must face them by staying true to mine! Time to grapple with my Princess☆Armlock!
